description: Source code for eswifi socket offload driver in Zephyr OS, implementing socket operations, TLS credential mapping, and DNS offloading.

methods.name: __process_received
methods.description: Handles received network packets and puts them into socket FIFO.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_listen
methods.description: Sets the socket to listen state.

methods.name: __eswifi_socket_accept_cb
methods.description: Callback for accepting incoming connections, copies address.

methods.name: __eswifi_socket_accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, prepares socket.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_accept
methods.description: Creates a new socket for an accepted connection.

methods.name: map_credentials
methods.description: Maps TLS credentials to internal format, handles credential retrieval.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_setsockopt
methods.description: Sets socket options, including TLS credentials.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_send
methods.description: Sends data over an established socket.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_sendto
methods.description: Sends data to a specific address; EOPNOTSUPP if address is specified.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_recv
methods.description: Receives data from socket FIFO.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_recvfrom
methods.description: Receives data; EOPNOTSUPP if from address is specified.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_close
methods.description: Closes and frees socket resources.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_open
methods.description: Creates a new socket and initializes it.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_poll
methods.description: Polls socket for events with timeout.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_bind
methods.description: Binds socket to local address.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_is_supported
methods.description: Checks if socket type is supported for given family, type, proto.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_create
methods.description: Creates a new socket and registers it.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_ioctl
methods.description: Performs IOCTL operations on socket.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_read
methods.description: Reads data from socket.

methods.name: eswifi_socket_write
methods.description: Writes data to socket.

methods.name: eswifi_off_getaddrinfo
methods.description: Performs DNS lookup and constructs address info.

methods.name: eswifi_off_freeaddrinfo
methods.description: Frees address info structures.
